name: Davies Elevated Guideway and Davies station

station.name: Davies
station.platform_footprint_note: lrt-tracks.json holds only the station node. No platform ring is stored for Davies. None was added.

geometry_source: docs/edmonton-bridges/lrt-tracks.json (OpenStreetMap via Overpass, extract 2026-10-14), routes 4 and 5 (kind bridge), station node Davies
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal WGS84 length along the stored nodes (haversine, mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m), one decimal. It is one track, not the pair. It is not a structural length. stored_length_m is the value the extract carries and differs by 1.5 m to 2.1 m; both are kept.

tracks.way_order_note: Node order runs from the south end (53.495637, -113.442378) to the north end (53.504944, -113.454872).
Node order runs from the north end (53.504932, -113.454936) to the south end (53.495638, -113.442445).

track_pair_plan_length_note: Two tracks as separate ways. Both are about 1.49 km in plan. Each is listed once above.
elevation_note: No elevations in the geometry. None were added.
dropped_note: Dropped, not in this folder: lrt-tracks.json routes 27 and 30 (surface, about 1,129 m each, south of the structure, toward T128 at 53.4852; K214 in lrt.md). Routes 37 and 38 (surface, about 5,145 m and 5,149 m, north of the structure, passing P156 Avonmore at about 615 m; K213 in lrt.md). These are at-grade K sections or approaches to other stops, not T127 bridge ways. T128 (53.4852, -113.4422) is a different structure and is not in the file as bridge ways near this box. Nothing else was dropped.
approach_note: No approach gradient or elevation change is in the geometry. The surface routes are plan lines only and are not a climb to grade.

osm_added_2026_11_23.source: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 map call, bbox -113.4580,53.4935,-113.4395,53.5070, read 2026-11-23 (ODbL). Added for the T127/P157 model (scenery-edmonton-bridges/tools/site_t127.py).
osm_added_2026_11_23.note: station_ways: the Davies station building (building=transportation, building:levels 4, roof:shape round, layer 2), the LRT platform and the bus station area. crossing_ways: every road and railway way that crosses the mean line of the two tracks; the model keeps filled-in pier stations 8 m clear of them. Current OSM also maps the tracks themselves (Valley Line, bridge=yes, layer 2) from 53.49564 to 53.50494, the same ends as `tracks`.

station_ways.role: Davies Transit Centre bus station area

osm_added_2026_11_23.park_and_ride_note: park_and_ride: the two ETS park-and-ride lots (amenity=parking, park_ride=yes, surface asphalt; together about 42,900 m2, for the 1,300 stalls Wikipedia gives), their parking aisles, and the ways that cut into them (grass islands, footways, cycleways, service roads, bus platforms).
